ambiguities_or_notes: Exact audited Russian Markdown source bytes were revalidated in this runtime against the pinned SHA-256.

The source is a telegraphic plan: sentence fragments, parenthetical alternatives, manuscript bracket completions, one illegible item, one uncertainty marker, and the deleted Russian-teacher note are all preserved.
French dépit, St. Jérôme, and maman remain visible as code-switches; the editorial gloss of dépit is translated as footnote 1.
отрочество / юность / молодость are rendered Boyhood / Youth / Young Manhood to preserve the four-stage developmental contrast with Childhood.
The source's stray bracket after кондитерская, compressed notation such as D[mitry] and K[atenka], and rough sequence around the Moscow/country notes are not silently repaired.
